claims.claim: Applied Materials identity/tradability is tied to NASDAQ:AMAT; current issuer Q3 FY2026 results provide primary operating, liquidity and debt evidence.
Issuer results and SEC-derived issuer materials are duplicate-origin collapsed; StockAnalysis is retained only as independent market-data lineage.

unknowns.unknown: Exact customer-level concentration is not quantified in this artifact.

claims.claim: Q3 FY2026 revenue was $9.115B versus $7.302B a year earlier and operating cash flow was a record $3.04B; management reported its 13th consecutive quarter of year-over-year gross-margin expansion.
At July 26, 2026 cash plus short-term investments were $9.233B versus $6.544B short- and long-term debt, supporting strong liquidity.
At Sep. 17 AMAT market cap was about $331.25B with trailing P/E 35.83 and forward P/E 23.61, so valuation is not treated as distressed despite strong growth.

thesisQuality.basis: Record growth/cash generation and semiconductor materials-engineering leadership support the thesis; cyclicality and customer concentration cap conviction.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: 35.83x trailing and 23.61x forward P/E reflect substantial expectations, offset by growth.
